dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Welcome, Mr. Flins. The wine you ordered previously has arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Why thank you, Mr. Demyan. Where would I find fine spirits here if not for your aid, I wonder...

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Ah, you're too modest, sir. Between us, I'd say you're the one with the more refined taste.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: The varieties you recommended before have been massive hits with our clientele. Why, our stock sold out before you could say "cider." Made a tidy profit off that, to boot.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Ah, I was simply giving you a few suggestions. If anything, I would credit this to your professional ethic as an alcohol tradesman.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: "No water mixed in, no low-quality drinks," you mean? Well, that has made me a fair shade less Mora, but it's also the reason we can continue operating.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Alright, sir, come with me. I've specially placed your wine in our cellar. You have our guarantee that it hasn't lost an iota of its flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I look forward to its. Oh, and could you bring two glasses? I believe we should partake of a sip or two first.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Of course, sir. Two glasses, one bottle, a beautiful moment.
